Tuesday · Grammar

Wh- Questions in the Past Simple

Question word + did + person + base verb?   When did she visit Babylon? · Where did they go?
With be: Where was the stone? · Who were the Sumerians?
Asking about the person who did it — no did: Who invented writing? → The Sumerians did. كلمة السؤال + did + الفاعل + الفعل في صيغته الأصلية. مع was/were لا نستخدم did. وعندما نسأل عن الفاعل (Who) لا نستخدم did.

Wednesday · Pronunciation

The -ed Ending: /t/, /d/ or /ɪd/?

/t/ after p, k, s, sh, ch, f, x: stopped · cooked · watched · laughed
/d/ after vowels and b, g, l, m, n, r, v, z: played · lived · called · opened
/ɪd/ after t and d only — an extra syllable: want-ed · visit-ed · need-ed
Careful: walked = one syllable (walkt), not "walk-ed". نطق -ed: يكون /t/ بعد الأصوات المهموسة، و/d/ بعد الأصوات المجهورة والحروف المتحركة، و/ɪd/ فقط بعد t و d (مقطع إضافي).
